about.title: About me
about.bio1: I have always loved puzzles and problem solving, from riddles and board games to computer games and real-life sports. An amazing computer science teacher at school turned that into a real interest and I have been enjoying Computer Science ever since.
about.bio2: I studied Computer Science at the University of Stuttgart, where my bachelor's thesis on trace abstraction solidified my desire to fully understand programs. I am now doing my M.Sc. in Software Engineering there, currently with an ERASMUS semester at the University of Limerick in Ireland.
about.bio3: After my ERASMUS semester, the master's thesis is the last step. I will most likely stay in program analysis for it as well. After that, from summer 2027, I am excited to finally work full-time in industry.

results.title: Tangible results
results.text: I like seeing progress early. Getting a first version running quickly and then improving it step by step keeps me motivated.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.text: Whether finding the optimal way of playing a game, optimizing processes or shaving time off of runtimes, efficiency is a word that I resonate with.

explaining.title: Explaining
explaining.text: Articulating knowledge is a skill that is difficult but very rewarding if done right. My tutoring jobs have taught me as much as I taught my students.
